item.title: GUSTAVE: Burundi's NILE Crocodile That Hunted 300 PEOPLE
item.description:
For over two decades, a single Nile crocodile in Burundi was blamed for the de*ths of up to 300 people — and he was never caught.
Gustave is the largest, most notorious Nile crocodile ever documented, stalking the Ruzizi River and Lake Tanganyika since the late 1980s. Herpetologist Patrice Faye spent years trying to trap him. This is the story of the crocodile that became a legend.
CHAPTERS: 0:00 – The Legend of Gustave 0:45 – Where Gustave Hunts: Burundi's Ruzizi River & Lake Tanganyika 2:30 – The First Reported Attacks (1987) 5:00 – How Big Is Gustave, Really? 7:15 – Patrice Faye's Obsession: The Hunt Begins 9:30 – The Trap That Almost Worked 11:45 – Why Gustave Was Never Caught 13:30 – The Last Sighting 14:20 – Fact or Legend?
